task: Find out what changed in the latest release of the library we depend on, and cite where you read it.

steps.//: The one external tool, evaluated without leaving the machine: the feature is on, no search provider is connected, and the call is refused before anything is sent anywhere. What is proven here is that the refusal is typed, says nothing was changed, names what to do next, and that the model acts on it instead of searching again. A live run uses the person's own connected provider and really searches.

args.query: library release notes latest version changes
